Question 3
?

Use the first three terms of the binomial expansion of (4+x)5 in ascending powers of x to approximate (3.89)5. Give your answer to three decimal places.

a
890.892
b
890.734
c
890.825
d
890.944
e
890.967
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

The binomial theorem for positive integer n states that

(a+b)n=(n0)anb0+(n1)an−1b1+(n2)an−2b2+…+(nn)a0bn.

By substituting a=4, b=x, and n=5, we obtain

(4+x)5=(50)(4)5(x)0+(51)(4)5−1(x)1+(52)(4)5−2(x)2+⋯=1(4)5+5(4)4(x)1+10(4)3(x)2+⋯=1024+5(256)(x)+10(64)(x2)+⋯=1024+1280x+640x2+⋯.

So, for small x, we have

(4+x)5≈1024+1280x+640x2.

Finally, we substitute x=−0.11 into the above approximation of (4+x)5:

(3.89)5=(4+(−0.11))5≈1024+1280(−0.11)+640(−0.11)2=1024−1280(0.11)+640(0.0121)=1024−140.8+7.744=890.944,

to three decimal places.
